table inet mcsbx_sandbox_egress {
	set new_conns {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set up_bytes {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set down_bytes {
		type ipv4_addr
		size 65535
		flags dynamic,timeout
		timeout 1m
	}

	set allow_dsts {
		type ether_addr . ipv4_addr
		flags interval
	}

	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		iifname "mcsbxeg0" ct state established,related accept
		iifname "mcsbxeg0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
	}

	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter - 10; policy accept;
		oifname "mcsbxeg0" iifname != "mcsbxeg0" ct state established,related update @down_bytes { ip daddr limit rate over 6250 kbytes/second burst 6250 kbytes } counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		oifname "mcsbxeg0" iifname != "mcsbxeg0" ct state established,related accept
		oifname "mcsbxeg0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		iifname "mcsbxeg0" jump egress
	}

	chain egress {
		meta nfproto ipv6 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		ip saddr != 10.231.0.0/24 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		ether saddr 06:6d:73:00:00:00-06:6d:73:ff:ff:ff ether saddr . ip daddr != @allow_dsts counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
		fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
		ip daddr { 0.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12, 192.0.0.0/24, 192.0.2.0/24, 192.168.0.0/16, 198.18.0.0/15, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24, 224.0.0.0/3 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
		tcp dport { 25, 465, 587 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with tcp reset
		ct state new add @new_conns { ip saddr limit rate over 50/second burst 100 packets } counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		update @up_bytes { ip saddr limit rate over 6250 kbytes/second burst 6250 kbytes } counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		accept
	}

	chain postrouting {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip saddr 10.231.0.0/24 oifname != "mcsbxeg0" masquerade
	}
}
table bridge mcsbx_sandbox_isolation {
	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		meta ibrname "mcsbxeg0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}
}
